caption: The drawing shows a stylized processional cross centered on a plain off-white background. The cross itself is a traditional Latin cross with trefoil ends on each of the four arms. The cross is primarily green with a gold-yellow outline and highlights. Below the cross, the staff is composed of alternating green and gold-yellow cylindrical segments separated by white zigzag bands. Near the base of the cross, there is a decorative round knob, also adorned with gold-yellow and green patterns. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "David P. Willoughby" is written in small green text. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Processional Cross
